name: Retry-attempt derived payload must be atomic

payload.description: A retry callback builds a publishable payload in captured mutable state; an attempt can fail after partial mutation, and either the error is swallowed or the next attempt appends onto residue.
positive_signal: closure mutates a slice, map, object, cursor, or summary declared outside the closure
a fallible call appears after one or more payload mutations
caller publishes the captured payload after retry returns
required_gates: force failure after a nonempty prefix
observe public success/error and payload cardinality or coverage
test per-attempt reset or attempt-local construction
safe_shapes: closure overwrites the whole payload before every fallible suffix
payload is local to each attempt and copied out only on complete success
postcondition proves exact source-domain coverage and uniqueness
payload.stop_rule: after proving one missing/duplicate published payload and the two-part counterfactual; do not enumerate batch counts or error strings

payload.fault_altitude: after first subtask meta append and before complete source coverage

cells: no fault: N source batches -> N published payload entries
prefix then swallowed error: N -> prefix length RED
propagated transient error without reset: N -> prefix+N RED
propagated transient error with per-attempt reset: N -> N GREEN

payload.effect: first batch meta exists before planner sees the error

rationale: the retry closure mutates an externally captured publishable slice before a fallible suffix
planner cardinality and live table/index consumers expose missing or duplicate coverage
the second-batch fault creates a nonempty failed-attempt prefix
the four cells distinguish swallowed error from retry residue
the TSO error occurs after one meta and before full range coverage

lessons.proof: nil error plus nonempty payload is not a completeness proof
error propagation alone retries onto failed-attempt residue

code_ref.counterfactual: return real error plus reset payload at attempt entry

lessons.causality: both retry signaling and attempt-local payload ownership are required

lessons.severity: successful online index DDL silently publishes an incomplete physical index and ordinary index plans miss committed rows
